title: 第2045章 两方面原因第2044章 你们没有救援
slug: 沉睡万年醒来一掌拍碎禁地
content_zh:
随后——
它向上联系，禀报所发生的一切，称现世这边有强者正在对它们进行扫除。
“还有这等事？可以，我们对他们展开反扫除！”
其上星空内的灰尘之地生物回应，派遣强者过来，要在造物星空内对陈长生等进行反扫除。
……
倒悬星空，绝地山脉那边。
一切恢复平静。
陈长生迈步向深处走去。
宋昀跟在身后，神色复杂而又纠结。
最后，他鼓足了勇气，走上前去，对陈长生说道：“您…您能帮我采摘到那株可起死回生的异草吗？我知道这样的要求很过分，也很无礼，但我真的没有了其它办法！”
他当即就要给陈长生下跪，恳求陈长生帮他采摘可起死回生的异草，复活他的挚爱！
“我知道于您而言，我什么都不是，可能连粒沙尘都比不上，我的命您更是看不上，但我最重要的便是我的命了！”
他哭着说道：“我只能用我的命来求您，您帮帮我吧！”
“不用这样！”
陈长生伸手，扶住要下跪的宋昀，道：“一株小草而已，没什么，随手便可得之，你也不用急在心里。”
随着他声音落地。
深处有绚烂光芒亮起，一株异草在绚烂光芒包裹中，飞到他这边。
“真有可起死回生的异草！”
这里的倒悬星空生灵震惊。
起死回生的异草，属于传说中之物，他们谁都没有见过，就连是否真实存在都还不能确定呢。

“拿下它，复活你的爱人吧。”
陈长生将起死回生的异草送给宋昀，并再次告诉宋昀不用记在心上。
于他而言。
起死回生的异草，真就是路边的杂草一株，什么都算不上。
“谢谢您！”
宋昀收起起死回生的异草，怎能不急在心里？
对于陈长生来说，这是一件微不足道的小事。
但对他来说。
这就是天大的恩情！
他纵然到死都不会忘记这等恩情，将来若他能够做到的话，他势必将会奉还陈长生这份天大的恩情！
深处高山耸立。
先前的接连大战并未对深处造成任何的破坏。
不止是这里。
整个倒悬星空都是如此。
火刀早用力量护住了整个倒悬星空，不可能会让倒悬星空在大战中受到波及。
陈长生走进深处里面。
“这里有长生哥要的东西吗？”
孟浪带着好奇地问道。
如陈长生这般强大，他实在不知这里能有什么东西吸引陈长生而来。
毕竟连这里最珍贵的那株起死回生异草，陈长生都没当一回事，直接就送给了宋昀。

“这里有些因果要解决。”
content_en:
Then——
It contacted upwards and reported everything that happened, saying that there were strong people here in this world who were cleaning them up.
"Is there such a thing? Okay, we can launch a counter-cleanup campaign against them!"
The dust land creatures in the starry sky above responded and sent strong men to counter-sweep Chen Changsheng and others in the creation starry sky.
…
The starry sky hangs upside down, beyond the Jedi Mountains.
Everything returned to calm.
Chen Changsheng stepped towards the depths.
Song Yun followed behind, his expression complex and tangled.
Finally, he mustered up the courage, stepped forward, and said to Chen Changsheng: "You...can you help me pick that exotic herb that can bring the dead back to life? I know that such a request is excessive and rude, but I really have no other option!"
He was about to kneel down to Chen Changsheng and beg Chen Changsheng to help him pick the exotic herbs that could bring the dead back to life and resurrect his beloved!
"I know that to you, I am nothing, maybe not even a grain of sand, and you don't even care about my life, but the most important thing to me is my life!"
He cried and said: "I can only use my life to beg you, please help me!"
"It doesn't have to be like this!"
Chen Changsheng stretched out his hand to support Song Yun, who was about to kneel down, and said: "It's just a small piece of grass, it's nothing. You can get it easily, so you don't have to worry about it."
As his voice fell to the ground.
There was a brilliant light in the depths, and a strange plant flew to him wrapped in the brilliant light.
"There really is a strange herb that can bring the dead back to life!"
The creatures hanging upside down in the starry sky here were shocked.
The strange grass that brings the dead back to life is a legendary thing. None of them have seen it before, and they are not even sure whether it actually exists.
"Take it and resurrect your lover."
Chen Changsheng gave Song Yun the rare herb that brought the dead back to life, and told Song Yun again not to keep it in mind.
For him.
The strange grass that brings the dead back to life is really just a weed on the roadside, nothing.
"Thank you!"
Song Yun put away the exotic herbs that brought the dead back to life, how could he not be anxious in his heart?
For Chen Changsheng, this was a trivial matter.
But for him.
This is a great kindness!
Even if he dies, he will never forget this kind of kindness. If he can do it in the future, he will definitely repay Chen Changsheng this huge kindness!
High mountains stand in the depths.
The previous successive battles did not cause any damage to the depths.
It's not just here.
The entire starry sky is like this.
The Fire Knife had already protected the entire Hanging Starry Sky with its power, and it was impossible for the Hanging Starry Sky to be affected in the war.
Chen Changsheng walked into the depths.
"Is there anything Brother Changsheng wants here?"
Meng Lang asked curiously.
As powerful as Chen Changsheng, he really didn't know what could attract Chen Changsheng here.
After all, Chen Changsheng didn't even take the most precious plant of reviving the dead seriously and gave it to Song Yun directly.
"There's some cause and effect to work out here."
